requirements.requirement: The system shall return parts search results in under 15 seconds.
requirements.source_citation: For parts searches, waiting around more than a few tens of seconds is unacceptable. We should aim to have search results returned well under, uh, something like fifteen seconds.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions a target time of under 15 seconds for parts search results, indicating a clear performance requirement.
requirements.follow_up_question: Are there any specific performance metrics or benchmarks that should be used to measure and ensure this requirement is met?

requirements.requirement: The system shall return facility search results in under 8 seconds.
requirements.source_citation: For the preferred repair facility search, that should be noticeably quicker — it should return within roughly eight seconds so the field person isn't standing there awkwardly.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions a target time of under 8 seconds for facility search results, indicating a clear performance requirement.

requirements.requirement: The system shall have an uptime of 98%.
requirements.source_citation: Our operations group will expect ninety-eight percent availability as the baseline. That implies downtime of about two percent of the time as the maximum tolerated.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions a target uptime of 98%, indicating a clear availability requirement.

requirements.requirement: The system shall support 1,500 concurrent users initially and scale to 10,000 concurrent users within two years.
requirements.source_citation: Today we should plan to comfortably handle fifteen hundred concurrent users, and architect it so we can scale to around ten thousand concurrent users within about two years of launch.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions the current and future user load, indicating a clear scalability requirement.
requirements.follow_up_question: Are there any specific scalability metrics or benchmarks that should be used to measure and ensure this requirement is met?

requirements.requirement: The system shall implement rate limiting, web application firewalls, traffic scrubbing, and failover paths to defend against attacks.
requirements.source_citation: Rate limiting, web application firewalls, traffic scrubbing — those kinds of defensive measures should be part of the plan. Also we should design failover paths so the core search capability has some resilience under load.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions specific security measures, indicating a clear security requirement.

requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions the need for role-based access control integrated with corporate identity and auditable, indicating a clear security requirement.
